title: One run of steps MIA keeps (core/runs.py, UI-1)
description: A browser routine, a taught skill, a workflow or (later) a plan across apps, as the person's run book keeps it: which engine runs it, what it runs, where it is, what it waits for, each finished step, and why it ended. Engines write it; screens, tools, the stop and recovery read it (DEC-0188; docs/mia_os/MIA_OS_UNIVERSAL_INTELLIGENCE_REVIEW.md sections 6 and 14).

ref.description: What it runs, by kind:id (browser_routine:ab12, skill:s1, creation:C-0002).

at.description: The step it's at, as a path: "3", or "2.then.0" for a nested step.

state.description: The engine's own private state; nothing outside the engine reads it.
